verdict.rationale: The SDK natively supports multi-agent orchestration. Handoffs let one agent delegate to specialist agents, and 'agents as tools' expose a subagent as a callable tool without a full handoff. Handoffs are captured in built-in tracing, and agents can mix models or providers within a workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of complex multi-agent workflows, and documented depth on orchestration patterns such as parallel or crew-style coordination.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Handoffs allow an agent to delegate tasks to another agent. This is particularly useful in scenarios where different agents specialize in distinct areas.
Agents as tools: expose an agent as a callable tool without a full handoff.
collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.
Mix models or providers across agents
